items.title: Pure effectiveness leaf (predictive value + arm comparison)
items.context: New core/experience-effectiveness.ts importing only node:/types. computePredictiveValue(orderedStories): for each story in order, using priorSignatures (union of signatureTags from earlier stories), compute pre-warnable findings, pre-warned (recall), would-have-hinted precision; aggregate overall + windowed trend (e.g. Spearman-style slope or per-window hit-rate like Baseline A). computeArmComparison(orderedStories): group by hintMode (on/off/unassigned), compute a recurrence outcome (e.g. fraction of findings whose signature was already known) per arm, return {nOn, nOff, outcomeOn, outcomeOff, delta, significant:boolean, note}. Significance is a conservative gate (e.g. require min N per arm; otherwise significant=false, note='insufficient N'). Pure; never NaN; deterministic.
items.userSees: Deterministic functions turning ordered per-story findings+signatures+arm into a predictive-value report and an ON/OFF comparison with honest N/significance.

items.title: Read-only learning_effectiveness handler + register
items.context: New handlers/learning-effectiveness.ts (model on learning_validate): build ordered stories from ctx.store (listStoryIds -> readStory createdAt order -> readFindings signatureTag) + read hintMode per story from readActivityLogTail experience_hint_surfaced events; run the leaf; render a human report (fast predictive-value overall+trend, then the ON/OFF readout with N + 'not yet significant') and --json. Optional --confirmedOnly to restrict to signatureTagSource=confirmed. READ-ONLY: writes nothing, no findings, no gate. Register in cli-engine/registry/config/command-policy (readOnly, allowedPhases all)/process-fact-levels (L0 experience-layer-read) AND READ_ONLY_COMMANDS.
items.userSees: Running `lattice learning_effectiveness` prints the predictive-value trend + ON/OFF arm readout (with N + significance); --json emits the structured report; nothing is written.

items.title: Smoke + npm script + verifier
items.context: New smoke: feed the leaf synthetic ordered stories (known signatures recurring across stories, known arms) and assert exact predictive-value (recall/precision) + arm comparison (N, outcome, significant=false when N small, true when a fixture crosses the threshold) + never-NaN + determinism; plus a CLI smoke that runs learning_effectiveness on a temp/real store and asserts a predictive-value line + nothing written. npm script + committed verifier (build + smokes + no-regression + full npm test incl. process-fact-contract; static: leaf pure; handler read-only/no projectRoot-persist/no finding/gate; registered across all 6 surfaces incl. READ_ONLY_COMMANDS + process-fact-levels). Maps every intent; TOTAL/PASS/FAIL.
items.userSees: npm smokes pass and the verifier prints PASS for the effectiveness metric.
excludes: No reliance on unrelated repo state in the hermetic leaf test
